published_G_checkpoint_observed.role: publication observation only; no automatic source acceptance/freeze

selected_contracts.terminal: AcquisitionRouteLoopReceipt@2.0: source_admitted_evaluation_retained; existing no-growth zero invariants and reentry meaning preserved

requirements: Full owner-recomputed effective basis of every actually skipped stage; no scalar/hash-WMR/ID-time proxy
Equality and current eligibility distinct, linearized under candidate/evaluation and native admission/overlay frontier
Common preparation consumed/revalidated by execution; no WMR/context/N4/N5 created merely for comparison
Preserve original evaluation lineage, source bookkeeping, requirement state and acquisition costs; no fictitious N5 or independence/currentness/authority
Reader-first/legacy exact dispatch/emitter-disabled rollout and rollback reader preservation
Controlled real sequential sources and fresh HTTP history, matched removals/crash/revocation/concurrent controls

basis_preparation_and_real_execution.rule: Pure common owner preparation and one comparison; actual reentry consumes same/revalidated plan, refs/delta no whole snapshot copies.

admission_decision_lifecycle_and_fold.rule: Positive selected admission then one shared semantic dispatcher for execute/recovery, current eligibility and protected full frontier, exhaustive v2 terminal/fold.

public_readers_and_surfaces.rule: Single Core retained evaluation tuple, v3 fresh GET and required clients/UI, readers first then emitter; no Core import of Runtime.

independent_semantic_oracle.rule: 18 scenario distinctions plus real preparation/N5 consumer, time cutoffs, multi-selector race and removal checks.

mandatory_companions: Mirrored tests, owner adapters/locks if required, public/generated schema/client/UI, README/release, tracked handoff and complete outputs; root sole canonical writer; companion scope outside mechanism counts.
